load_glb_mesh: load a GLB mesh file into a PyTorch3D Meshes object using IO and MeshGlbFormat
render_mesh_with_phong: render a PyTorch3D mesh using HardPhongShader with configurable camera distance, elevation, and azimuth
test_load_glb_with_textures: test loading a GLB file with textures and compare vertex UVs and texture maps against an OBJ reference
test_load_glb_no_textures: test loading a GLB file without textures and assign synthetic vertex colors for rendering
render_mesh_with_ambient_light: render a pre-lit mesh scene using AmbientLights and FoVPerspectiveCameras for indoor environments
